subject: MAP readiness: internal roles and evaluation plan for Orion Health PoC
messages:
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP readiness: Orion Health PoC — roles, eval plan, ask list

Morning team —

We have the internal prep for the Orion Health MAP kickoff next week. Attaching the draft MAP (Orion_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) and the security FAQ they asked for. I want us aligned on who owns which rows and who will be the direct point for each stakeholder category. High level asks:

- Confirm RACI for the top 8 milestones in the attached MAP (I sketched proposed owners in column D).
- Confirm evaluation plan owners + who will run the model performance checks and data validation steps.
- Identify any gating items (legal/infra/security) that we should escalate now.
- I'll send a short pre-read to the customer on Monday; please get edits back by EOD Monday.

Proposed roles (please confirm or suggest alternatives):
- Commercial lead: laura_bennett (customer success & timelines)
- Technical lead / deployment owner: marcus_lin
- Evaluation & metrics owner: priyom_das
- Security / SOC2 evidence: monica_patel
- Stakeholder communications and scheduling: jordan_blake

RACI shorthand I used in the sheet: R = Responsible, A = Approver/Owner, C = Consulted, I = Informed.

Quick timeline we're aiming for (PoC scope):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): finalize MAP & evaluation plan; access requests submitted
- Week 1: onboarding + baseline run (accuracy & latency numbers)
- Week 2: iterate on prompts/configs and rerun benchmarks
- Week 3: final evaluation + signoff (decision to proceed to dedicated or hosted)

Attachments: Orion_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (MAP draft), Security_FAQ.pdf (customer security questions we've answered so far).

Please reply inline with confirmations or edits. I will collate and send the pre-read to Orion on Monday at 10:00 PT.

Thanks —

--
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP readiness: Orion Health PoC — roles, eval plan, ask list

On Fri, 12 Jun 2026 at 09:03, laura_bennett@redwood.ai wrote:
> Morning team —
>
> We have the internal prep for the Orion Health MAP kickoff next week. Attaching the draft MAP (Orion_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) and the security FAQ they asked for. I want us aligned on who owns which rows and who will be the direct point for each stakeholder category. High level asks:

Thanks Laura — quick confirmations from my side:
- I can take Technical lead and will own the infra checklist, deployment runbook, and the initial latency/throughput benchmarks.
- For the baseline run in Week 1 I need a sandbox dataset (PII redacted) from the customer and an IP allowlist for their VPC if we route privately.

Two asks:
1) Monica, can you confirm whether the customer has provided their SOC2 attestation yet? If not, we'll need to surface the top 10 items they care about from the Security_FAQ.
2) Laura, recommend we add Legal (contract) as a consulted party on the acceptance criteria row — they will need to weigh in on data residency and retention language.

Also: I'll add a short infra-acceptance checklist to the MAP (ETA Monday noon).

- Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP readiness: Orion Health PoC — roles, eval plan, ask list

Thanks — adding a few notes on the evaluation plan (I updated the "Evaluation" tab in Orion_MAP_v1.2.xlsx):

- Metrics we should capture: top-line intent accuracy (customer-defined examples), hallucination rate on 500 random samples, 95p latency for 1, 4, and 16 token completions, and memory/KV cache growth for 8k-context probes.
- Data access: I'll need read-only S3 creds or an export of the sample set. If we can't get live access, we should ask customer for a 3-day sample export and a data schema.
- Acceptance criteria proposal: intent accuracy >= 85% on their labeled set AND noP0 hallucination incidents in the last 500 queries. Suggest Legal sign-off on the acceptance criteria as Marcus noted.
- Owner matrix: I propose priyom_das as primary for metrics runs, marcus_lin as secondary (infra support), laura_bennett as approver for go/no-go timeline decisions.

Questions:
- Jordan — can you coordinate a 30-minute dry-run for the baseline run with the customer (ideally Tue or Wed next week)?
- Monica — can you add the SOC2 doc location or tell me which controls we need evidence for?

I'll schedule the evaluation baseline job as soon as I get credentials; plan will take ~8 hours compute (estimate single-run).

-priyom

--
Priyom Das
ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP readiness: Orion Health PoC — roles, eval plan, ask list

Thanks everyone — noted and a couple additions from Security/Compliance: 

- SOC2: Orion has provided an older SOC2 Type II report (2024). I'll attach the current evidence bundle to the shared drive by EOD Monday. For the MAP, we should flag controls: Access Control (AC-2 equivalent), Logging/Monitoring (SI), and Data Retention/Deletion (DR).
- Security_FAQ.pdf (attached) has answers to 12 initial questions; I'll add two more rows about network isolation and key management.
- Action items assigned (as an inline RACI):
  * Evidence collection: monica_patel (R) / laura_bennett (I)
  * Legal review for acceptance criteria & data residency: laura_bennett (C) / marcus_lin (C) / monica_patel (R)
  * Evaluation runs & metrics: priyom_das (R) / marcus_lin (S) / laura_bennett (A)
  * Scheduling dry runs: jordan_blake (R) / laura_bennett (I)

I'll upload the evidence bundle and the updated Security_FAQ to the drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1XyZ_example_link

If no objections, I'll merge the changes into Orion_MAP_v1.2.xlsx and prepare the Monday pre-read to send to the customer.

-Monica
